groups.summary: Downstream consumers should not need to regex free-form review prose or reconstruct a PR's intent from raw diffs.
groups.title: Replace prose-only review state

files.summary: Adds the structured-finding parser, receipt currentness, and PR cognitive-aid validation/render plumbing.
Pins canonical enums, bounds, lineage, anchors, ordering, and graceful degradation.
Defines the product-neutral structured-findings consumer contract.

groups.summary: Pure-stdlib plumbing normalizes bounded findings, portable anchors, durable lineage, and invalid-versus-absent behavior without new model or network calls.
groups.title: Parse findings deterministically

files.summary: Exercises backend writers, recovery, concurrency, import safety, currentness, and performance.
Makes RepoPrompt review setup durable, context-bound, and directly consumable.

groups.summary: Receipt writers retain immutable generations and project only the valid current tip; prompt formats remain parser-compatible and token-neutral.
groups.title: Persist current findings across every review path

files.summary: Defines host composition, deterministic validation/currentness, and Markdown insertion rules.
Pins identity, provenance, history selection, validation rejection, rendering, and latency.

groups.summary: Make-pr now validates and persists an intent-ordered artifact, selects one current generation, and renders deterministic Markdown without replacing the independent risk-ranked review plan.
groups.title: Publish one head-bound PR walkthrough
